component.name: WindowScene
component.script:
sub init() m.top.backgroundUri = "" m.top.backgroundColor = "0x000000FF" m.posters = [m.top.findNode("a"), m.top.findNode("b")] m.front = 0 m.lastUrl = "" m.crossfade = 3 m.fadeIn = m.top.findNode("fadeIn") m.fadeOut = m.top.findNode("fadeOut") m.inInterp = m.top.findNode("inInterp") m.outInterp = m.top.findNode("outInterp") m.server = CreateObject("roAppInfo").GetValue("server_url") m.top.findNode("hint").text = "Waiting for " + m.server ' The Roku keeps its own rotation (the panel's mounting), separate from the web display's. ' Left/right on the remote turn it 90 degrees; it's remembered on the Roku. saved = CreateObject("roRegistrySection", "window").Read("rotation") if saved = "" then saved = "270" layout(saved.ToInt()) m.top.setFocus(true) for each p in m.posters p.observeField("loadStatus", "onLoaded") end for m.task = CreateObject("roSGNode", "PollTask") m.task.server = m.server m.task.observeField("display", "onState") m.task.control = "RUN" end sub
' Fill the screen. For 90/270 the poster is portrait-sized and turned (positive rotation is ' counter-clockwise on Roku, clockwise on the web page, hence the minus). sub layout(degrees as integer) m.rotation = degrees for each p in m.posters if degrees mod 180 = 0 p.width = 1920 p.height = 1080 p.translation = [0, 0] else p.width = 1080 p.height = 1920 p.translation = [420, -420] end if p.scaleRotateCenter = [p.width / 2, p.height / 2] p.rotation = -degrees * 3.14159265 / 180 end for end sub
function onKeyEvent(key as string, press as boolean) as boolean if not press then return false if key = "right" turn = 90 else if key = "left" turn = 270 else return false end if layout((m.rotation + turn) mod 360) reg = CreateObject("roRegistrySection", "window") reg.Write("rotation", m.rotation.ToStr()) reg.Flush() return true end function
sub onState() s = m.task.display if s.crossfade <> invalid then m.crossfade = s.crossfade if s["type"] = "blank" m.lastUrl = "" fade(invalid, m.posters[m.front], 20) else if s["type"] = "show" and s.url <> m.lastUrl m.lastUrl = s.url back = m.posters[1 - m.front] back.uri = "" back.uri = m.server + s.url ' onLoaded fades it in once it has loaded end if end sub
sub onLoaded(event as object) p = event.getRoSGNode() back = m.posters[1 - m.front] if p.loadStatus <> "ready" or not p.isSameNode(back) then return m.top.findNode("hint").visible = false fade(back, m.posters[m.front], m.crossfade) m.front = 1 - m.front end sub
' Fades start from each poster's current opacity, so nothing flashes back after going blank. sub fade(incoming as dynamic, outgoing as object, seconds as dynamic) if seconds < 0.1 then seconds = 0.1 m.fadeIn.control = "stop" m.fadeOut.control = "stop" if incoming <> invalid m.inInterp.fieldToInterp = incoming.id + ".opacity" m.inInterp.keyValue = [incoming.opacity, 1.0] m.fadeIn.duration = seconds m.fadeIn.control = "start" end if m.outInterp.fieldToInterp = outgoing.id + ".opacity" m.outInterp.keyValue = [outgoing.opacity, 0.0] m.fadeOut.duration = seconds m.fadeOut.control = "start" end sub
